Two of the new blocks are ready to try. Reload **http://maker:4001/app.html**.

**Block A — permanent delete (distinct from Archive):**
> On any item, press **Delete**. Notice it doesn't vanish immediately — it asks **"Delete permanently? This can't be undone,"** with **Delete permanently** / **Keep**. Confirm on a throwaway item and it's gone for good. Contrast this with **Archive** right next to it, which only hides-and-keeps and is fully reversible.

**Block B — editing the address itself:**
> Press **Edit details** on an item. There's now an **Address** field at the top. Change it to a different valid link and **Save changes** — the item updates (and its icon follows the new address). Then try two safeguards: (a) clear the address or type nonsense and save — it refuses with a note; (b) change it to match a link you already have saved — it refuses, telling you addresses must be unique.

A couple of things to confirm:

- For **delete**, is an **inline "are you sure" confirmation** the right level of protection (versus deleting instantly, or a heavier pop-up)? And should delete be available in this same row, or would you prefer it tucked away a bit to avoid accidental clicks?
- When you **edit an address** to one that already exists, I chose to **refuse and keep them separate**. Would you ever instead want it to *merge* into the existing one? For now I've kept it simple with a refusal.
